newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close unchanged in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close unchanged in light trade.

text.p: The Delhi Stock Exchange closed early on Thursday in protest against a breakdown in air-conditioning in the bourse building, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 0.22 point down at 801.02 points after light early trade.
"There were very few participants in the absence of any trends from other bourses," said broker Sanjay Mittal.
Most major markets, including the Bombay Stock Exchange, were closed for May Day.
Hindustan Lever Ltd fell 18.75 rupees to 1071.25 on profit-taking.
Reliance Industries closed 0.25 rupee down at 308.25.
ACC Ltd rose six rupees to 1,491.
